header.description: Share the basics and I’ll confirm scope, timing and price. A phone number or email plus a short description is enough to start; photos and address can be added if useful.

expect.title: What to expect
expect.description: Here’s what typically happens after you submit your request.
steps: I review your details, postcode and photos if you include them.
I may contact you with a couple of quick questions.
I send a clear estimate and suggested timeline.
If needed, I schedule a short site visit.
You approve the quote and I book the job.

calculatorSummary.title: Pricing calculator estimate
calculatorSummary.note: Rough guide only. Final pricing depends on photos, access, and exact scope.

form.title: Quote request
form.description: Start with your name, one contact method and a short description. Add address, service type, timeframe, budget or photos only if they help.
form.photosHelp: Optional, but helpful. Add clear photos from a few angles if you have them.
form.maxPhotosError: You can upload up to 5 photos.
form.jobDetailsPlaceholder: Example: lawn needs fortnightly mowing in Newquay, hedge is overgrown, or garden needs a one-off tidy. Include access notes if useful.
form.toastSuccess: Quote request received. I'll be in touch soon.
